name: Mystical Performance (Gestalt)*
body:
Your performances are infused with a magical quality.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, Perform 3 ranks, Skill focus (Perform)

Benefit: You can create magical effects using your Perform skill, much like a bard can. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + your Charisma modifier. Each round, you can produce any one of the types of bardic performance that you have mastered. When you take this feat, choose two of the bardic performances that a bard gains at 1st level (countersong, distraction, fascinate, or inspire courage). You can use either of those two performances when using Mystical Performance. When determining level-dependent effects of performances, treat your bard level as your character level – 2. This otherwise functions just like a bard’s bardic performance ability.

Special: You count as having the bardic performance class feature for the purpose of qualifying for feats (such as Extra Performance).
